title: Harbison Protection Contracts Price List by Scope and Capacity
content:
Harbison Protection Contracts are priced by tier, by scope (a single unit or a matched indoor and outdoor system) and by capacity band. All prices are in US dollars. Capacity is the nominal tonnage on the equipment register; heating-only equipment is priced in the single-unit up-to-3-tons column, and for a matched system the band follows the outdoor unit.

| Tier | Single unit, up to 3.0 tons or heating-only | Single unit, over 3.0 tons | Matched system, outdoor unit up to 3.0 tons | Matched system, outdoor unit over 3.0 tons |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | $489.00 | $579.00 | $789.00 | $929.00 |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | $879.00 | $1029.00 | $1389.00 | $1619.00 |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | $1289.00 | $1489.00 | $1989.00 | $2289.00 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | $1749.00 | $1999.00 | $2689.00 | $3089.00 |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | $2249.00 | $2549.00 | $3389.00 | $3889.00 |

**Scope, inclusion and installation discount.**

| Tier | Matched-system scope available | Issued at no charge with every Harbison installation | Discount when bought on the installation contract |
|---|---|---|---|
| Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty | yes | yes | 0% |
| Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection | yes | no | 10% |
| Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection | yes | no | 10% |
| Harbison 10-Year Parts & Labor Protection | yes | no | 10% |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection | yes | no | 10% |
| Harbison 12-Year Total Protection Plus | yes | no | 10% |

**Notes to the price list.**

- Matched-system scope can be bought on every tier.
- Only the Harbison 2-Year Workmanship Warranty is issued at no charge with every Harbison installation; it is the only tier priced at $0.00 in every column.
- The installation discount is a percentage of the listed price. Hypothetical illustration: the Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection on a single 2.5-ton unit lists at $879.00; 10% of that is $87.90, so the price bought on the installation contract is $791.10.
